request.style: English, epic orchestral carol, warm male baritone with choir, strings, oboe, harp, French horns, timpani, frame drum, a long journey under the stars, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Far away in the east we watched the night sky turn
A new star was rising and we saw it burn
Over desert and mountain we followed its light
To Jerusalem's gates and King Herod's court by night

[Chorus]
Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews
We saw his star when it rose
And we have come to worship him

[Verse]
The king was disturbed and Jerusalem too
The scribes searched the scrolls till they found what was true
In Bethlehem of Judea the ruler will be born
So we rode on in the darkness before the morn

[Chorus]
Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews
We saw his star when it rose
And we have come to worship him

[Verse]
The star went ahead till it stopped where he lay
We rejoiced with exceedingly great joy that day
We saw the child with Mary and we fell down at his feet
Gold, frankincense, and myrrh we gave, our journey was complete

[Bridge]
And you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah
Are by no means least among the rulers of Judah
For out of you will come a ruler
Who will shepherd my people Israel

[Outro]
Warned in a dream, we went home by another way
We have come to worship him
